name: One&Only Palmilla
insider_take: Where Hollywood legends once escaped and Jack Nicklaus perfected his masterpiece—this is Cabo's crown jewel with a legendary past.
whats_special: One&Only Palmilla sits on the original site of a 1950s fishing lodge that hosted Old Hollywood stars like John Wayne and Bing Crosby. The resort features the acclaimed Palmilla Golf Course, designed by Jack Nicklaus, which winds dramatically along desert cliffs overlooking the Sea of Cortez. The property's chapel, Templo de la Luz, is one of Mexico's most sought-after wedding venues.
pro_tip: Book tee times at Palmilla Golf Course during sunset hours—the 5th and 6th holes offer breathtaking views as the sun dips into the Pacific, and you might spot migrating whales during winter months.
dont_miss: The resort's weekly "Legends of Palmilla" storytelling sessions where staff share tales of celebrity guests from the golden age, and the exclusive beach access to one of Los Cabos' few swimmable beaches where the Sea of Cortez meets calmer waters protected from Pacific swells.
pros: Stunning beachfront location on pristine Los Cabos coastline
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
Multiple award-winning dining venues with ocean views
cons: Remote location requiring transportation to downtown Cabo
